description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: Extend web_widget protocol validation, response/state reducers and existing message UI to accept server descriptors and display downloadable files. Use the session-authorized file route; preserve history reload and connector isolation. Track package change and compatible ZAQ mix.exs/mix.lock update explicitly. Follow sibling repository AGENTS.md before work there; do not alter unrelated worktree changes or claim unshipped package support.

Tests to add before implementation: Protocol/state/component tests for multiple files, history, download URL/session behavior, inaccessible or removed files, expired sessions and text-only responses. Keep browser scenario authoring deferred to its gate.

Branches/paths validated: Disk/Drive, initial and resumed conversation, reconnect, live delivery/history parity and safe error feedback.

Mocking plan: External authentication/provider edges only; real package rendering/state and ZAQ integration where feasible.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: Widget package protocol/integration documentation and ZAQ docs/services/web-bridge.md compatibility instructions.

Action reuse assessment: Extend existing widget response/state/UI owners and reuse the file API; no additional download service, authorization implementation or agent tool.

Implementation handoff: Scope and sequence approved by the user on 2026-11-28. This turn records the plan only; application implementation, commits, pushes, rebases and dependency publication are not performed or authorized by this planning update. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before execution. Read applicable service guides and module responsibilities; Agent work requires the harness-critical checks; BO work requires DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md. Recheck live source and dependency contracts. Preserve existing test behavior unless specifically approved. Write immediate unit/integration/property tests before corresponding code; new browser journeys wait for the human UX gate. Keep real internal boundaries, mock only external edges, and inject runtime dependencies through existing opts/context and Zaq.Config. Follow the owning validation lifecycle. PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
